name: censof-tools
description: Censof internal Claude plugins — the GRP knowledge base connector and the tools built on it.

plugins.name: censof-mcp
plugins.description: Search the GRP knowledge base — 101k closed RFS tickets, Acumatica documentation, and the GRP manuals — and diagnose a support ticket end to end with the rfs-analyze skill.

plugins.name: grp-mcp
plugins.description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude — read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across all five of Acumatica's APIs. Connects straight to your own instance; credentials never leave your machine. Bundles its own Python runtime.

plugins.name: grp-mcp-mac
plugins.description: The Acumatica plugin for macOS and Linux. Same server as grp-mcp, started a different way: grp-mcp bundles a Windows binary that will not run on a Mac, so this one runs the same code from PyPI through uvx. Needs uv. Install one or the other, never both.
